blocks_conflicts.description: true in a mode that blocks conflicts unless they are overridden.

conflicts.description: The conflicts the members' roles and the pending invitations' roles hold now. A switch to a mode that blocks conflicts waits until each is resolved, or overridden with a reason.

history.description: Every version, oldest first; empty until the first switch.

mode.description: Founder mode allows the conflicts of §6.3 with the compensating controls FM-1 to FM-9; Standard and Enterprise mode block them (PRD-001 §6.4).

overrides.description: The overrides for the version in force: who keeps a conflict, and why (reported, §6.4).

version.description: The team mode's version: 0 until the first switch; it also makes the ETag.
